rationale: Fire caused direct damage to kitchen cabinets and smoke damage to ceiling and walls, which is a clear property damage claim covered under homeowners insurance.
claim_summary: Kitchen fire from grease flare-up on stove; charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. Damage contained to kitchen. Covered under homeowners policy with $500 deductible and $250,000 limit.

case_facts.description: Fire caused by grease flare-up on stove while sauteing onions; extinguished with fire extinguisher
case_facts.damage_type: Charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls
case_facts.extent_of_damage: Localized to kitchen; rest of house unaffected
